---
title: "Ground Penetrating Radar"
---

This section focuses on pavement Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR), including FDTD simulation of layered and heterogeneous pavement systems, layer interfaces, thin layers, cracks, voids, moisture, and groundwater effects.
